title: Assistant Manager - Production
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
**Assistant Manager – Production**
.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for leading production operations and driving operational excellence across safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance. You will ensure efficient manufacturing processes, strong team performance, continuous improvement, and adherence to Autoliv Production System (APS) standards while supporting customer and business objectives.
  
  
You will need to deliver a safe, productive, and quality-focused manufacturing environment while achieving performance targets and building a culture of continuous improvement.
  
  
Should you be interested in overseeing these tasks and aiming for enhanced performance standards, your role will involve:
  
  

* Leading day-to-day production operations and ensuring achievement of production targets.
* Ensuring production teams are appropriately resourced and working according to APS defined standard processes.
* Driving Health & Safety, Quality, Productivity, Cost, and Delivery (PDD) performance targets.
* Conducting daily production meetings and communicating production status, priorities, and critical issues.
* Escalating risks and coordinating recovery actions to ensure uninterrupted production flow.
* Optimizing manufacturing and support processes to improve efficiency and performance.
* Ensuring compliance with work instructions, quality systems, environmental requirements, and labor regulations.
* Analyzing production and quality reports and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Leading productivity improvement and cost optimization projects across the manufacturing function.
* Developing and executing annual operating plans aligned with business objectives.
* Supporting policy deployment and leading performance improvement initiatives at plant level.
* Implementing Lean Manufacturing, JIT, JIDOKA, Visual Management, and World Class Manufacturing practices.
* Driving line balancing activities using MOST time calculations and manpower optimization techniques.
* Developing value stream maps and identifying opportunities for waste elimination and process improvements.
* Leading FMEA activities and supporting quality assurance during new process establishment.
* Promoting and facilitating Kaizen, Quality Circle, and Continuous Improvement initiatives.
* Implementing and strengthening Autoliv Production System (APS) practices throughout the plant.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams and other Autoliv locations to share best practices.
* Developing team capabilities through training, coaching, and skill enhancement programs.
* Building a strong team culture aligned with Autoliv values and one-company philosophy.
* Managing production capacity according to forecasted demand and customer requirements.
* Participating in crisis management activities and supporting production recovery plans.
* Preparing departmental budgets and supporting investment and cost planning activities.
* Leading teams to achieve customer expectations with effective cross-functional collaboration.

**If You Have/are**

* Diploma with 12–15 years of experience or B.E. in Mechanical/Automobile Engineering with 6–8 years of relevant experience.
* Experience in production management within the automotive or manufacturing industry.
* Hands-on experience managing assembly line operations and troubleshooting manufacturing processes.
* Strong exposure to multinational manufacturing environments.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, APS, World Class Manufacturing, JIT, JIDOKA, and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Experience with line balancing, MOST time calculations, value stream mapping, and productivity improvement.
* Knowledge of quality systems, FMEA, process controls, and root cause analysis.
* Strong leadership, team management, and people development skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Flexibility to work in shifts and support six-day working schedules.
* Additional education or training in Safety is an advantage.
* Fluency in English; knowledge of Kannada, Hindi, and Tamil is desirable.

**Key Competencies**

* Drive Customer Focus
* Display Global Perspective
* Cultivate Innovation
* Make Sound Decisions
* Manage Execution
* Ensure Accountability
* Drive Collaboration
* Engage & Inspire Others
* Develop People
* Build Trust
* Strong Leadership Skills
* Result Orientation
* Problem Solving
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

**Personal Attributes for Success**

* Self-confident and proactive approach.
* Strong team player with collaborative mindset.
* Innovative thinker with a continuous improvement focus.
* Result-oriented with strong execution capabilities.
* High level of ownership and accountability.

title: Associate Manager - Packaging
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
**Associate Manager - Packaging**
.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for establishing and leading packaging engineering processes for new and existing programs while ensuring efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective packaging solutions across the supply chain. You will need to deliver innovative packaging designs, optimize logistics and transportation costs, ensure customer delivery fulfillment, and support cross-functional teams in achieving project timelines and operational excellence.
  
  
Should you be interested in overseeing these tasks and aiming for enhanced performance standards, your role will involve:
  
  

* Establishing packaging engineering standards, processes, and best practices across the organization.
* Leading packaging development activities for new projects while ensuring adherence to project timelines.
* Designing packaging solutions for supplier-to-plant and plant-to-customer material movement.
* Collaborating with Quality, SCM, Engineering, Buyers, PMO, Vendors, and Customers across global locations.
* Developing and implementing cost-effective packaging solutions while maintaining quality and safety requirements.
* Designing packaging and load configurations considering ergonomics, transportation, and regulatory compliance.
* Leading sustainable packaging initiatives to reduce scrap generation and improve environmental performance.
* Developing packaging for incoming raw materials in coordination with sourcing and procurement teams.
* Managing packaging specification design, validation, testing, and release processes.
* Creating and maintaining Packaging BOMs, packaging standards, part numbers, and engineering documentation.
* Driving returnable packaging development, including fleet sizing calculations and container planning.
* Identifying opportunities for packaging and logistics cost reduction, including reverse logistics optimization.
* Supporting vendor development activities and evaluating new packaging materials and technologies.
* Driving continuous improvement initiatives, waste elimination (Muda reduction), and packaging optimization.
* Preparing Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and delivering training programs for stakeholders.
* Designing packaging solutions for dangerous goods while ensuring compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Monitoring project progress and communicating reports, risks, and issues to management.
* Ensuring on-time delivery and achieving 100% customer delivery fulfillment.

**If You Have/are**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in Packaging Engineering, Packaging Development, or Supply Chain Packaging.
* Strong knowledge of automotive components and manufacturing processes.
* Hands-on experience in packaging design, development, testing, and validation.
* Knowledge of various packaging materials, transportation requirements, and recycling processes.
* Experience in project management and new product/program launches.
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
* Experience in packaging cost optimization and logistics improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of returnable packaging systems and container planning.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross-functional and global teams.
* Fluency in English; knowledge of Kannada and Hindi is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**Key Competencies**

* Take Ownership
* Add Value
* Collaborate
* Make it Easy
* Be Curious
* Proactive Mindset
* Innovative Thinking
* Strong Analytical Skills
* Customer Focus
* Results Orientation
* Problem Solving
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.
  
  
In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. title: Equipment Engineering Manager
description:
**Responsibility**
Lead the equipment engineering, maintenance, equipment installation, qualification and continuous improvement activities for EMI shielding processes in an OSAT manufacturing environment.
  
  
The role will be responsible for establishing and sustaining a highly reliable, automated and scalable equipment infrastructure covering EMI shielding processes such as attach, pre treatment, sputtering, detach and AOI.
  
  
The position will work closely with Technology development, Process Engineering, Quality, SCM and Operation to ensure successful equipment selection, installation, qualification, capacity ramp up and sustained HVM performance.
  
  
Technology Roadmap
  
  

* Participate in evaluating equipment suppliers, technology maturity, scalability, automation and total cost of ownership.
* Drive standardization of equipment platforms, critical spares, software and control systems wherever practical.

Equipment Installation and Commissioning
  
  

* Lead equipment installation, commissioning for ramp-up for EMI shielding manufacturing lines. Ensure equipment readiness against NPI and HVM ramp schedules.
* Coordinate with suppliers for equipment installation, debugging, performance improvement and acceptance.
* Establish equipment acceptance criteria covering UPH, uptime, reputability, process capability, safety and quality.

Maintenance & Others
  
  

* Establish robust PM and predictive maintenance programs for all  critical equipment.
* Define maintenance frequencies based on equipment reliability, failure history and OEM recommendations.
* Establish critical spare-parts strategy and inventory levels.
* lead structured 8D for chronic equipment failures.
* Establish equipment capability before transferring processes to HVM.
* Drive automation and digitalization initiatives such as SPC integration, Recipe management etc.
* Develop a roadmap toward smart manufacturing with improved equipment visibility and reduced manual intervention.
* Develop local supplier capability for critical maintenance and spare parts wherever feasible.
* Drive cost reduction through equipment modification, automation, localization and spare parts optimization.
* Develop 24\*7 support capability for HVM operations.
* Promote a strong zero-repeat failure and preventive maintenance culture.
* Lead equipment safety risk assessments to ensure corrective actions are being implemented.

**Essential Attribute**

* Knowledge of Emi shielding requirements, Shielding effectiveness, coating thickness control and SoC is highly desirable.
* Strong focus on reliability, quality, safety and cost.

**Qualification**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  
  
**Desired Experience Level**
20 years of relevant experience in manufacturing, with at least 5 years in a leadership or managerial role.

title: Production Supervisor
description:
**Role Description** 
 The Production Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kanakapura. This role oversees daily production operations to ensure output meets quality, safety, and delivery standards. Responsibilities include organizing and monitoring production schedules, coordinating resources and materials, and aligning team activities with production plans. The Production Supervisor guides and supports production staff, conducts shift briefings, resolves operational issues, and enforces safety and compliance procedures. The role also involves tracking performance metrics, identifying process improvements, and collaborating with management to meet production targets and optimize efficiency.
 



  





**Job Summary** 

  
 




  





 The Production Supervisor will oversee daily operations of the offset printing and packaging department, ensuring production targets, quality standards, and safety protocols are met. This role involves managing shop\-floor staff, coordinating with other departments, and driving continuous improvement in press and packaging operations.
 
  
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 

  
 




**Production Planning \& Execution** 

  
 



* Plan, schedule, and supervise daily offset printing and packaging operations to meet production targets and delivery deadlines.
* Allocate manpower, machines, and materials efficiently across shifts.
* Monitor job progress and resolve bottlenecks in press runs, finishing, and packing lines.



  





**Quality Control** 

  
 



* Ensure printed and packaged products meet quality standards (color accuracy, registration, finishing, packaging integrity).
* Conduct regular quality checks and coordinate with QC teams to minimize rejections and rework.
* Investigate quality complaints and implement corrective actions.



**Team Supervision** 

  
 



* Supervise, train, and motivate press operators, packaging staff, and helpers.
* Assign duties, monitor performance, and conduct shift briefings.
* Manage attendance, discipline, and performance evaluations of team members.



  





**Machine \& Process Management** 

  
 



* Oversee offset press operations (e.g., sheet\-fed/web offset), die\-cutting, folding, binding, and packaging equipment.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules with the maintenance team to reduce downtime.
* Optimize processes to reduce waste, material costs, and cycle time.



  





**Safety \& Compliance** 

  
 



* Enforce workplace safety standards and ensure proper use of PPE.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, ISO standards, and statutory regulations.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard\-free production floor (5S practices).



**Reporting \& Coordination** 

  
 



* Maintain production records, downtime logs, and shift reports.
* Coordinate with planning, procurement, design/pre\-press, and dispatch teams for smooth workflow.
* Report daily/weekly production output, efficiency, and issues to management.



  





**Required Qualifications** 

  
 



* Diploma/Degree in Printing Technology, Graphic Arts, Packaging Technology, or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of offset press operations, pre\-press workflow, and post\-press/packaging processes.
* Familiarity with color management, ink/substrate properties, and finishing techniques (lamination, die\-cutting, folding, gluing).



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 

  
 




  




* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities on the shop floor.
* Knowledge of production planning and lean manufacturing/5S practices.
* Basic computer skills (MS Office, ERP/production software).
* Effective communication skills for cross\-department coordination.
* Ability to work in shifts and handle production pressure.



  





**Working Conditions** 

  
 



* Factory/shop\-floor environment; may require standing for extended periods.
* Rotational shift work, including weekends/holidays as per production needs.
